basics.label: Healthcare Implementation Specialist | Workflow Design | Client Onboarding | AI Automation
basics.summary: Healthcare implementation and workflow specialist with 12+ years across U.S. RCM, credentialing, payer operations, client onboarding, business analysis, analytics, automation, and remote delivery. Maps current-state workflows, defines target processes, translates needs into structured requirements and acceptance conditions, coordinates stakeholders, manages risks and follow-up, and supports QA, training, go-live readiness, and stabilized handoff. Strong PHI awareness and practical experience designing human-reviewed AI-enabled healthcare workflows.
